functions.name: badPlace_Arc
functions.description: Creates a bad place arc. AI will flee this position if they can, and will not go into it if they can avoid it.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the bad place. If name is not "", the bad place can be moved or deleted by using the unique name.

params.name: duration
params.description: If duration > 0, the bad place will automatically delete itself after this time. If duration <= 0, the bad place must have a name and will last until manually deleted.

params.name: origin
params.description: The base position of the bad place.

params.name: radius
params.description: The radius of the blad place.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the bad place.

params.name: direction
params.description: The direction vector is used to give a reference frame for the left and right angles.

params.name: right angle
params.description: The left angle and right angle are both positive angles (eg, "45, 45" will give a 90 degree arc).

params.name: left angle
params.description: The left angle and right angle are both positive angles (eg, "45, 45" will give a 90 degree arc).

params.name: team
params.description: You must specify at least one team for which this place is bad, but can give several. The allowed teams are "axis", "allies", and "neutral".

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the bad place. If name is not "", the bad place can be moved or deleted by using the unique name.

params.name: duration
params.description: If duration > 0, the bad place will automatically delete itself after this time. If duration <= 0, the bad place must have a name and will last until manually deleted.

params.name: brush entity
params.description: The brush entity representing the bad place.

params.name: team
params.description: You must specify at least one team for which this place is bad, but can give several. The allowed teams are "axis", "allies", and "neutral".

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the bad place. If name is not "", the bad place can be moved or deleted by using the unique name.

params.name: duration
params.description: If duration > 0, the bad place will automatically delete itself after this time. If duration <= 0, the bad place must have a name and will last until manually deleted.

functions.name: beginLocationSelection
functions.description: Causes the player to begin selecting a location. A map HUD element should be visible for them to see where they're selecting. Works with endLocationSelection(). When the user confirms or cancels, they will recieve a notify "confirm_location" or "cancel_location". The former notify contains the location they selected, as a vector.

params.name: location selector
params.description: Name of the material to use as a cursor on the map. Must be precached with precacheLocationSelector().

params.name: selector size
params.description: The radius of the cursor material in world units. Cannot be larger than the entire south-to-north span of the minimap. If not specified, will be 15% of the south-to-north span of the minimap.

functions.name: setAnim
functions.description:
SetAnim and all of its variants set the weight of an animation (or a node in the animtree) to a given value over a given time. They also set the speed at which the animation plays. All of the ancestors of the animation will also have their weight set to 1 over the given time so that the animation is visible. Each variant of this function has different behavior depending on the words in the function name:

"Flagged": These functions take an additional argument (first in the argument list) which is a string that is notified for every notetrack in the animation. For instance, if the string "runanim" is used, it would be typical to waittill("runanim", "end") to wait for the end of the animation. must be an actual animation and not a non-leaf node of the animtree.

"Knob": These functions turn the weight of any siblings of the animation to zero as the animation's weight is turned up. The effect is that after the given time, the animation is the only one out of its siblings that is playing. Note that the descendents of the siblings of the animation will not be turned off directly. (For this, use ClearAnim.)

"All": Works only with "Knob." Not available with both "Limited" and "Flagged" at the same time. These functions take an additional argument (after the animation argument). must be an ancestor of in the tree. This has the additional effect that "Knob" has on all nodes from the animation up to (but not including) , so that this animation is the only one in its area of the tree which is playing.

"Limited": These functions do not change the goal weight of the ancestors of (If "KnobAll" is used, this means the ancestors of ). This means that the animation might not be visible if any of its ancestors currently have a weight of 0. However, when its ancestors' weight is changed, it will become visible.

"Restart": These functions cause the animation to restart. If they had been previously playing, without this they would continue from their current time.

params.name: animation
params.description: The animation or animtree node to change.

params.name: weight
params.description: Goal weight of this animation. Defaults to 1.0.

params.name: time
params.description: Time to transition to this weight in seconds. Defaults to 0.2.

params.name: rate
params.description: Playback rate of the animation. Defaults to 1.0.
